newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus bourse rises after lows.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus bourse rises after lows.

text.p: Cyprus's Stock Exchange registered gains of 0.50 percent on Friday after a loss of 5.20 percent on shares in the first four trading days of the week.

Shares on the 41-share bourse, which has its general index set at 100 points, closed at 74.27 points on Friday. On Thursday it closed at 73.90, its lowest level since the market started official transactions in March last year.
On Thursday Cypriot Finance Minister Christodoulos Christodoulou announced tax breaks for investors and companies.

Under the regulations, 30 percent of investments in new companies listing on the exchange will be tax deductible and tax exemptions will be allowed on the first 1200 pounds ($2,400) paid in dividends.
The board of the exchange is in consultation with the finance ministry to look at ways to encourage more companies to float shares on the bourse.

Christodoulou said the decline in stocks was primarily a correction of prices which followed the artificially inflated highs in the months immediately before the official launch of the bourse in March 1996.

Banking stocks closed on Friday at 84.49, down 3.5 percent from last week's close of 87.58. Bank of Cyprus fully paid shares closed at 314.5 on Friday from 324.5 last week. Fully paid shares in the Popular Bank closed at 307.5, 10.5 cents down from last week.
Hellenic Bank HBCP.CY closed at 250.5, from 262 last week, while the Universal Savings Bank registered gains of three cents to 141.

The approved investment sub index closed at 62.27, down 10.2 percent. Hera Portfolio shares closed at 115 on Friday from 124 last week. Cytrustees middle trading price was 125.5 on Friday, from 136.5 last week.
Insurance company Universal Life closed at 397.5, up 9.5 cents. Paneuropean dropped 13.5 cents to 99 cents.
Cement producer Vassiliko was trading at 139 on Friday from 149 last week, while beer and wine producer Keo were trading at 104 from 108 last week.
National carrier Cyprus Airways was trading at 32.5 cents from 31.5 last week.
